name: Gai Noi
whatItIs: Lao restaurant by Chef Ann Ahmed; lunch and dinner, walk-in only.
evidence: Own site lists hours Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm and online ordering; named to Mpls.St.Paul Magazine's 2026 list of 50 best Twin Cities restaurants.

name: Khâluna
whatItIs: Southeast Asian restaurant and shop by Chef Ann Ahmed; name means 'please' in Lao; logo border drawn from the Lao sinh skirt.
evidence: Own site lists current dinner and weekend brunch hours, menus and reservations.

name: Soul Lao
neighborhoodOrCity: Sibley Plaza, Highland Park / West Seventh, St. Paul
whatItIs: Lao restaurant that began as a food truck in 2017; owners Sabrina Boualaphanh and Eric Phothisanh; also serves customers at Wandering Leaf Brewing next door.
evidence: Named on Mpls.St.Paul Magazine's 2026 best-restaurants list; a dated review of a visit was posted Oct. 29, 2025 (myannoyingopinions.com). Own website not found.

name: Ruam Mit Thai + Lao Cuisine
neighborhoodOrCity: Downtown St. Paul (367 Wabasha St. N.)
whatItIs: Thai and Lao restaurant founded in 1989; owned since late 2018 by Nia Rasavong, who came to Minnesota from a Thai refugee camp; reopened downtown in 2024.
evidence: Its online ordering page, opened Oct. 31, 2026, takes pickup and delivery orders from 367 Wabasha St. N. and lists Lao dishes such as khao piek sen, khao poon, nam khao and mok pa; a restaurant guide refreshed Oct. 30, 2026 (spinach.guide) lists daily hours at that address.

name: Lat14 Asian Eatery
whatItIs: Southeast Asian restaurant Chef Ann Ahmed opened in Golden Valley in 2018, where, Twin Cities Business wrote, her Laotian heritage took the stage.
evidence: Website loads with menu headings but shows no hours, dates or current content; a menu page returned 404 on Oct. 31, 2026. No 2025 or 2026 dated item opened.

name: Top Asian Food
whatItIs: Asian food business owned by one Thai and one Lao family in 2017.
evidence: Only source opened is a February 2017 MPR News photo caption.

name: New Orient Market
whatItIs: Market described as a key source of Southeast Asian ingredients for Lao cooks; ownership not stated.
evidence: Mentioned in an Oct. 1, 2024 article; no 2025 or 2026 source opened; not confirmed as Lao-owned.

name: Lemon Grass Thai Cuisine
whatItIs: Chef Ann Ahmed's first restaurant, a Thai restaurant with Lao dishes, run by Laotian owners and chefs.
evidence: CCX Media reported on March 24, 2023 that it was closing that Saturday, March 25, 2023, after 18 years.

name: 1st of Thai
whatItIs: Family Thai restaurant owned by Hom Sithisack, who came from Laos in 1985 after time in a camp in Nong Khai, Thailand; the family opened in Albertville (2002), Plymouth (2005) and Faribault (about 2010).
evidence: Faribault Daily News profile (undated, about 2016) and a Carleton College student interview with the owner's son; no 2025 or 2026 dated item or own website opened.

name: Lao Thai (Family Lao Thai Restaurant)
neighborhoodOrCity: University Avenue, St. Paul (501 University Ave. W.)
whatItIs: Long-running family Lao and Thai restaurant on University Avenue, reviewed by Heavy Table in 2013 and Mpls.St.Paul Magazine.
evidence: The reviewer later added on the same page that the restaurant had closed or been sold (comment undated); its listed website did not load on Oct. 31, 2026.

name: Viet Hoa Lao market
whatItIs: Southeast Asian grocery with produce, rice, frozen meats and seafood and a small kitchen; ownership not stated.
evidence: Only source opened is an October 2018 blog visit; not confirmed as Lao-owned.

name: Sahtu Press
whatItIs: Lao American book publisher founded in 2013, with poet Bryan Thao Worra among its founders; says its books are printed in Minnesota.
evidence: Articles page lists posts dated Jan. 2, Sept. 30 and Oct. 19, 2026, and a 2026 publishing plan.
